threads.body: The runtime plugin version is still `1.1.9` in `settings.gradle.kts:10`, so this change leaves the metadata/compile-time API on 1.1.10 while all applications of `org.graalvm.buildtools.native` still resolve 1.1.9. Please update the plugin-management declaration to 1.1.10 as part of this dependency bump so the versions remain synchronized.
threads.hunk:
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 import org.graalvm.buildtools.gradle.dsl.GraalVMReachabilityMetadataRepositoryExtension
 
 // Keep this in sync with the org.graalvm.buildtools.native plugin version in settings.gradle.kts.
-val graalvmReachabilityMetadataVersion = "1.1.9"
+val graalvmReachabilityMetadataVersion = "1.1.10"

replies.body: Updated `settings.gradle.kts` to use `1.1.10`. I also corrected the Renovate grouping to match the plugin marker coordinate (`org.graalvm.buildtools.native:**`), so future plugin and Maven artifact updates land in the same PR.
